Name: Victor to Victoria
Author: Otsuke00
Description:
This file contains sprites and a dialogue file that you can install in order to change Victor into a female version, named Victoria. This requires you to have Stardew Valley Expanded, and a seasonal outfit mod compatible with it.

You need to download the files, and then drop and let them replace the files you already have.

For the portraits and sprites, simply go to where your seasonal outfit mod stores all the images, and drop the new ones there.

For the changed dialogue, you need open the file called i18n, located here in your mod folder: \Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\i18n and then drop the file default.json in.

There will likely still be instances where NPCs call Victoria Victor, or use the wrong pronouns. Let me know, and I'll try and fix it.
